question.text: The clearing corporation interacts with which of the following entities through electronic connection?

answer.text: Stock Exchange, clearing banks, clearing members, custodians and depositories
Only stock exchanges and clearing banks

explanation.text: The Logic: The clearing agency interacts with the Stock Exchange, clearing banks, clearing members, custodians and depositories through an electronic connection. The Trap: The CC sits at the centre of a network of these entities, so options that restrict the interaction to only one or two of them are incorrect. Note: The list of counterparties (Stock Exchange, clearing banks, clearing members, custodians, depositories) is the source-stated set with which the CC has electronic connectivity.
